rationale: Price has recovered from the gap-down low and holds above VWAP ($51.87) and the 9-EMA, but the last five 1-minute candles show it pinned in a 2-cent band at the session high (97% of range) with rising volume and no price progress — absorption/stall without a trigger in either direction.
